reports.title: Lure Review: Black Label OFO
reports.text:
This tough urchin-style lure won’t warp or wilt
Black Label Tackle entered the urchin-style soft plastic craze with a big splash at the right time with arguably one of the most advanced models, the Outstanding Fishing Object (OFO).
Cliff Pace, an accomplished Bassmaster Elite angler who won the 2013 Bassmaster Classic at Oklahoma’s Grand Lake O’ the Cherokees, had ideas how to make it better and ran with it after working with different factories.
The Black Label Tackle/Wood Bait Country owner started the company’s urchin project last year, then six months later introduced the OFO in late spring 2026. That the OFO hit the market riding the rapidly building wave of urchin popularity was…
